message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout during a massive storm. I was in the middle of a family group chat, and just like that, my phone battery was down to 5%. I felt that panic rise until I remembered my trusty power bank tucked away in the drawer. I charged my phone and kept the family updates flowing—no one wants to miss out on the latest storm drama! 🌩️ It's a good reminder to keep those tech essentials ready, just in case. What’s your go-to tip for staying connected during a power outage?
